reasons.specificity: The analysis tracks Castoriadis's distinctive moves—regime-defined product/cost, collective fuzzy-boundary production, the Kaldor/Kalecki distribution frame, the periodized globalization argument, the Maurice of Nassau example—rather than generic externality critique, and it names specific sections and arguments throughout.
reasons.anchoring: Nearly every finding carries a verbatim anchor drawn from the text and used correctly: 'the regime itself decides upon what a product is,' 'purely conventional and arbitrary,' 'free gifts of history,' 'collectivity whose boundaries are fuzzy,' 'somehow or other functioned within its limits,' and others; interpretations match the actual textual context, not just surface wording.
reasons.non_obviousness: The analysis usefully distinguishes the paper's rejection of separate imputation from a mere externality argument, recovers the provisional status of the near-homogeneous abstraction, and notes the counter-evidence that the text accepts approximate regularities and concedes limited functioning—distinctions a casual reader of Castoriadis would likely miss—though the globalization reframing is fairly patent from the text.
reasons.coherence: The inclusion/exclusion table, alternative-boundary table, findings ledger, and prose narrative attribute claims consistently to the same passages, use the same finding codes, and maintain consistent scope distinctions (source-stated vs. analyst-proposed) throughout.
reasons.usefulness: The inclusion/exclusion rows and alternative-boundary table with source/analyst labeling give a reader navigating Castoriadis's dense text a structured entry point to the boundary argument and its consequences, and the open-questions section honestly marks what the paper leaves unresolved.
reasons.hallucination_risk: Analyst-proposed reframings are explicitly labeled as such and grounded in retained source findings; no claims of quantified magnitudes, invented consensus, or false absences appear; the scope-assessment section appropriately limits coverage claims to the supplied text; no decisive unsupported assertions were found.

score.one_line: A well-anchored, consistently attributed boundary reading that distinguishes source claims from analyst reframings and avoids overreach, with minor missed depth on the historical-contingency and autonomous-society arguments.
